Today we're going to talk about a very special beverage.
Tea has been consumed for thousands of years, and it's one of the most popular drinks in the world.
The story of tea began in ancient China.
Legend has it that Emperor Shen Nong discovered tea accidentally when leaves from a wild tea bush fell into his pot of boiling water.
Fascinated by the pleasant aroma and taste, he started to promote tea as a medicinal drink.
Tea spread from China to Japan around the eighth century, where it became deeply integrated into Japanese culture, including the development of the tea ceremony.
By the seventeenth century, tea reached Europe, where it became extremely popular, especially in Britain.
The British East India Company played a significant role in importing tea, and tea became a staple of British culture.
Today, tea is enjoyed in various forms around the globe, from traditional loose-leaf tea to tea bags and iced tea.
Tea culture continues to evolve, with innovations like bubble tea, a tea-based drink that emerged in the eighties and has become trendy, especially with young people.
